title: Test specimen inside a large machine
visual_facts: A block-shaped gray specimen marked 3A(LP) stands in the center of a circular metal platform.
A dark rectangular block rests on top of the specimen.
Red and pale wires are attached to the specimen's front and sides.
The circular platform is inside a larger machine with a broad dark upper platen above it.
Two blue vertical supports frame the specimen on either side.
spatial_relations: The specimen stands on the circular platform beneath the upper platen.
Wires extend from the specimen toward the sides of the machine.
uncertainties: The machine's exact type and the purpose of the test are not identified.
The full marking on the specimen may be incomplete or partially obscured.
